payload.claim: `_tracked_symlinks`'s described `git ls-tree -r -z` call omits `-c core.quotePath=false`, unlike every other path-listing call in saffron/repos/mirror.py (changed_files, both git grep call sites in removed_name_readers, retirement_markers), whose own docstring explains git quotes and octal-escapes any path outside plain ASCII by default. A literal build that omits the flag would, for a tracked symlink at a non-ASCII path, return an octal-escaped path that never matches the plain path grep_hits or file_at use, silently losing such symlinks from the union and the sort order, with no witness in this spec exercising a non-ASCII path to catch it.
